The Barafeshwar Mahadev Temple, surrounded by a serene park and a quaint pond, offers a tranquil escape. The temple's architecture is captivating,
Although it is that maintained but park provides a peaceful environment for contemplation. The small pond adds to the charm, making it a delightful place to experience spirituality and nature in harmony.

featured_reviews.name: Prabhakar Jha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Barfeshwar Mahadev Temple near Barafpada Virar East is a hidden gem that offers visitors not only a spiritual experience but also a fun and enjoyable time for kids. The temple is situated in a beautiful location, surrounded by water, which creates a calm and peaceful atmosphere.

One of the most appealing features of this temple is the park space it offers for kids to play. The park has a variety of swings, slides, and other play equipment that will keep children entertained for hours. The park is well-maintained, clean, and safe, making it a great place for families to spend quality time together.

In addition to the park, there are also several food vendors around the temple that offer a variety of snacks and refreshments, which can be enjoyed by adults and children alike. Visitors can also take a walk around the lake or take a dip in the  waters surrounding the temple.

The temple itself is dedicated to Lord Shiva and has a rich history that dates back over 500 years. It is a small and simple temple, but is still very beautiful and well-maintained.

Overall, Barfeshwar Mahadev Temple near Barafpada Virar East is a must-visit destination for families looking for a combination of spirituality and fun. With its beautiful location, park space for kids, and variety of refreshments, it is sure to be a memorable experience for all who visit.
